notes: TBox insert of an area rule for the fictional Morvadine figure (a kind of plane figure). Before the insert nothing gives its area. The answers are fol: Z3 checks all three queries. The class axiom is encoded here for the structural check only.
edit: MorvadineFigure ⊑ PlaneFigure and has_formula value area_2pi

queries.not_checked: fol (arithmetic): an area from a radius

fol.notes: The area of a Morvadine figure of radius r is the model's belief, an uninterpreted function of r; the rule is instantiated for the two radii the questions use (4 and 1). π is a constant pinned to 14 decimal places, so the multiples of π the answers name are single values (the answers' choices spell them as numbers).

local.morv_area: the area of a figure of radius r, as the model believes it (record-local rule)
